name: tech-selection
description: >- Gated checklist for choosing a technology (library, framework, storage, data format, model, build-vs-buy, architecture) or reviewing a proposed one. If favorites-search is installed, MUST run it before external research. Returns surviving candidates with trade-offs, not a single pick. Use for 用哪个 / 选什么框架 / 要不要自建 / A 还是 B / 这个方案行不行, and before the agent commits to one. Not for research reports (use deep-research).
author: daymade
